build_replay.method: One source root and one target directory; forced first local-crate codegen then base/candidate/base/candidate rebuilds. Dependencies reused; all binaries saved before timing. Source restored in finally.

plan.method: Eight serial Williams blocks, fixed CPU, no concurrent project builds. Full unchanged 112-label min9 suite, standalone controls, synthetic end-to-end pipelines. Retained corpus primary is process median; paired implementation ratio uses geometric mean of its two mode medians. Eight independent process blocks, not 176 independent repetitions. All RUM_* cleared then retained GC batches=3.
plan.limits: Same host/toolchain, synthetic workloads, no real application distribution. Williams predecessor balance holds within blocks; seven boundary transitions are separately recorded and not balanced. A/A samples expose but do not subtract noise. Source/target replay reproducibility rules out observed repeated-build variation here, not compiled-code layout effects or general compiler nondeterminism.

plan.followup_reason: Primary original-suite Part/Sort regressions persist; standalone Part retained a result alias unlike the suite, and synthetic mixed-control16k showed large same-binary A/A variation. Isolate session context rather than change implementation.
plan.method: Each mode/case is a fresh process, warm once then11 retained timings. Full expected results and aliases checked outside each window. Part returns Null and validates contents separately, matching the suite ownership pattern. Fresh pipelines use exactly the existing per-case generator. Eight balanced mode blocks with both A/A controls; descriptive followup selected after seeing primary outcomes, not a confirmatory independent trial.

static_comparison.scope: Selected function bytes and address-normalized disassembly only
static_comparison.limitation: Address normalization is lossy; equality does not prove identical data, transitive callees, execution behavior, or a cause of timing differences.

limitations: Eight descriptive paired blocks; repetitions within a process are not independent blocks.
No real application corpus, cross-machine validation, or whole-runtime acceleration claim.
All slower suite medians are retained. A 5% threshold does not excuse smaller regressions.
Rebuild byte reproducibility does not identify the cause of any persistent timing difference.
raw_evidence_hash_scope: Committed redacted files, recursive relative paths
